dev_time_pass.layout: Layout: Hazel's Bakery (north dock), Front Gate (town square), Garden Hose Stand (east meadow), arranged in a loop around the goose's starting pond.
building_specs: Hazel's Bakery (shop): features oven that can overheat and puff flour.
Front Gate (structure): features gate that can open and close.
Garden Hose Stand (prop): features hose that can spout water.
appearances: Hazel: a baker with a look reflecting sedentary, candid, excitable, astute -- palette and silhouette chosen to read at a glance.
Otto: a teacher with a look reflecting sedentary, reserved, flat, astute -- palette and silhouette chosen to read at a glance.
Vic: a gym instructor with a look reflecting energetic, candid, excitable, dull -- palette and silhouette chosen to read at a glance.

building_specs: Hazel's Bakery (Hazel's Bakery (shop): features oven that can overheat and puff flour.): the goose can grab/pick up it; residents notice and react according to their personality. No task-critical state here can become permanently unrecoverable -- it resets to a safe default if left alone.

Front Gate (Front Gate (structure): features gate that can open and close.): the goose can honk/duck it; residents notice and react according to their personality. No task-critical state here can become permanently unrecoverable -- it resets to a safe default if left alone.

Garden Hose Stand (Garden Hose Stand (prop): features hose that can spout water.): the goose can grab/dash it; residents notice and react according to their personality. No task-critical state here can become permanently unrecoverable -- it resets to a safe default if left alone.
item_specs: a family memento (memento): the goose can grab/pick up it; residents can notice, retrieve, or discuss it. if dropped or hidden outside of active use, a family memento drifts back to its owner or origin after a short time -- it can never become permanently lost.
